description: Gets one hospital's public record by CCN, or by name with a two-letter state. The record includes the address, CMS overall star rating, hospital type, owners from CMS ownership records, private equity flag, last ownership change, published outcome measures, and whether OpenHealth holds a current price file for the hospital.

ccn.description: The hospital's six-character CMS Certification Number (CCN), such as 360006.

name.description: The hospital's name, such as Riverside Methodist Hospital. Use it with state when you have no CCN.

state.description: A two-letter US state code, such as OH. A hospital name needs this code.

name: get_hospital
title: Get a hospital's public record
